title: Kosmosdan ko'rinadigan narsani mitti jonzotlar qurgan...

scenes.text: Bu tuzilmaning uzunligi taxminan 2300 kilometr. Uni kosmosdan olingan suratlarda ham ko'rish mumkin.
Uni quruvchilarning ko'pi atigi bir necha millimetrlik mitti jonzotlar.
Bu Avstraliya qirg'og'idagi Katta to'siq rifi. Uni marjon poliplari ming yillar davomida qurgan.
Rif taxminan 2900 ta alohida rifdan iborat. 1981 yilda UNESCO ro'yxatiga kiritilgan.

description:
Avstraliyadagi Katta to'siq rifi taxminan 2300 kilometr cho'zilgan va kosmosdan olingan suratlarda ko'rinadi. U taxminan 2900 ta alohida rifdan iborat, uni marjon poliplari qurgan. 1981 yilda UNESCO Butunjahon merosi ro'yxatiga kiritilgan.

Siz buni bilarmidingiz? Izohda "ha" yoki "yo'q" deb yozing.
source: Web fact-check 2026-11-20 (web search summaries; pages could not be opened from this session). Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Authority reef facts (gbrmpa.gov.au/learn/reef-facts: Marine Park about 2,300 km along the Queensland coast); UNESCO World Heritage Centre (inscribed 30 Oct 1981; about 2,900 individual reefs within the property; other publications say about 3,000); NASA Earth Observatory and Visible Earth, ESA (reef photographed by astronauts and satellites, 2,300 km system; the naked-eye 'visible from space' claim is popular but not confirmed by NASA, so the text says 'suratlarda'). Built by coral polyps over thousands of years (GBRMPA). Title left as is: satellite images do show the reef.
